mapper.sql: ROLE_ID, ROLE_CODE, ROLE_CHNAME, RECORD_STATUS, SYS_CODE, CREATE_TIME, CREATE_USER, UPDATE_TIME, UPDATE_USER, REMARK

where.if: AND (ROLE_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR ROLE_CHNAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))

mapper.select: SELECT r.ROLE_ID, r.ROLE_CODE, r.ROLE_CHNAME, r.RECORD_STATUS, r.SYS_CODE, r.CREATE_TIME, r.CREATE_USER, r.UPDATE_TIME, r.UPDATE_USER, r.REMARK FROM PT_ROLE r INNER JOIN PT_USER_ROLE ur ON r.ROLE_ID = ur.ROLE_ID WHERE ur.USER_ID = #{userId}
